title: Netflix's December 2026 Movies and Series Lineup
excerpt:
Netflix's December slate includes animation, documentaries and dramas.
Ray Gunn and Cliff Booth are among the highlighted releases.
body_md:
A newly published lineup outlines films and series expected to arrive on Netflix during December 2026. The selection includes Miraculous World: London and Miraculous World: Tokyo, a limited Pride and Prejudice series, and the first season of Love Is Blind: South Africa.

Documentary programming includes The Murder of JonBenet Ramsey and Phoenix Jones: The Rise and Fall of a Real Life Superhero, alongside a seventh season of My Next Guest Needs No Introduction with David Letterman. The article highlights Ray Gunn for December 18 and The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth for December 23.

Availability can vary by region, and the feed's list does not specify an individual premiere date for every title. Dates not explicitly provided should not be treated as confirmed.
